title: Serie A title-winning managers 2005/06 to 2014/15
brief: Name the manager who won Serie A in each season from 2005/06 to 2014/15.

notes.Fabio Capello: Fabio Capello led Juventus to first place in 2004/05 and 2005/06, but both titles were taken away in the Calciopoli scandal; 2005/06 went to Mancini's Inter.
notes.Marcello Lippi: Marcello Lippi won 2001/02 and 2002/03 with Juventus, before this board.
notes.Carlo Ancelotti: Carlo Ancelotti won 2003/04 with AC Milan, before this board.

checks: Every season's title-winning manager agrees between Wikipedia's list of Serie A winning managers and Transfermarkt's list of champions with their coaches. 2004/05 has no champion (the title was stripped from Juventus and not reassigned), so no ten-season window can include it. 4-slot rule checked for every window: only 2005/06 to 2014/15, 2006/07 to 2015/16 and 2016/17 to 2025/26 pass (Allegri has 4 or more in every window starting 2007/08 to 2015/16). The two windows that don't overlap are kept. Clubs: 2005/06 Inter, 2006/07 Inter, 2007/08 Inter, 2008/09 Inter, 2009/10 Inter, 2010/11 AC Milan, 2011/12 Juventus, 2012/13 Juventus, 2013/14 Juventus, 2014/15 Juventus.
